# Whale Isle 0.3.12

- **No more lag**: Idle CPU and GPU use drops from nearly a full core to about 7%. The default flowing gradient background now advances at 12 frames per second, which still reads as continuous motion, and stops while the window is minimized or in the tray. The startup scene covered by the main window no longer keeps animating. Dragging windows and switching apps on integrated-graphics PCs no longer stutters.
- **Automatic step-down on integrated graphics**: When an integrated GPU or software rendering is detected, the background effect and the startup transition start off, and Appearance explains why. Settings you changed yourself are kept, and you can turn the effect back on at any time.
- **No more stealing focus**: If the first start takes a few minutes and you switch to another app meanwhile, the main window flashes in the taskbar when it is ready instead of jumping to the front. Startup no longer flashes a black console window.
- **Updates and quitting are never blocked**: A confirmed update proceeds after at most 10 seconds even while background tasks or subagents are still running, instead of reporting that running work could not be ended. Quitting from the tray or the window starts closing within 3 seconds, so one click is enough. When the launcher stops or updates the desktop app, a desktop app that does not exit is ended.
- **Steadier online downloads**: Full downloads, the checksum manifest and version checks now follow the system proxy like the browser does, and fall back to a direct connection when the proxy app has quit. Fixes full downloads that reset or timed out behind a proxy while incremental updates worked.
- **CNB by default in mainland China**: Until you pick a download route, Simplified Chinese systems or China time zones use the CNB mirror; elsewhere GitHub stays the default. A route you already picked is unchanged.
- **Smaller incremental updates**: The runtime inside the installer is now packed so unchanged parts are reused instead of downloaded again. This takes effect for updates from this version onward; for example the runtime part shrinks from about 92 MB to about 21 MB. Releases that upgrade Electron remain close to a full download.

This release provides the Windows 10+ x64 installer and the macOS 14+ Apple Silicon installer (unsigned and not notarized; right-click and choose Open the first time). Updating from 0.3.11 is still performed by the old version; if it reports that running work could not be ended while many background tasks run, quit from the tray first and then install. The Android client is released separately and is not updated by this desktop version. WhaleBridge and the ChatGPT plugin are installed and updated independently and are not bundled with the desktop package.
